Name: Trainium1
Notes:
Trainium1 (and the very similar Inferentia2 chip) does not have an official TDP spec.

To estimate, note that AI chips generally become 40% more efficient per year: https://epoch.ai/data-insights/ml-hardware-energy-efficiency  

Trainium1/Inferentia2 and Trainium2 were separated by two years, suggesting a ~2x efficiency improvement based on trends.

Trainium2 is 500W and 667 TFLOP/s in 16-bit FLOP/s. Trainium1 is 190 TFLOP/s in 16-bit (note that the Trainium1 and Trainium2 have a slightly different ratio of 16-bit to 8-bit op/s; I'm using 16-bit which is likely more representative for Trainium1).

So Trainium1 TDP theoretically would be roughly 190/667 (compute ratio) * 500 W (Trainium2 wattage) * 2x (efficiency penalty for older chip) = 284W, rounded up to 300W.
